title: TMX tileset images not found - app crashes on launch
description:
The app loads levelone.tmx successfully but crashes because tileset images are not found. Console shows:
- SKTexture: Error loading image resource: "Assets/Maps/roughrippleearthdarktograsstileset"
- SKTexture: Error loading image resource: "Assets/Maps/treestileset"  
- SKTexture: Error loading image resource: "Assets/Maps/windmilltileset"
- SKTexture: Error loading image resource: "Assets/Maps/minetileset2"

Then crashes with: Fatal error: Index out of range in ContiguousArrayBuffer.swift:691

The tileset paths in TMX files reference Assets/Maps/*.png but these images need to be either:
1. Copied to the bundle at the correct paths, or
2. TMXRenderer updated to look for them in the correct location

title: Fix Xcode bundle resources - TMX files not copied to app bundle
description: The app builds successfully but displays "Could not find levelone.tmx" at runtime. Root cause: The project uses PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup but "Nathaniel Shared" folder is not included in either target's fileSystemSynchronizedGroups. Need to add 96B123862EDB62E100C1F1CA to both iOS and macOS targets' fileSystemSynchronizedGroups arrays in project.pbxproj.
